Security researcher Matthew "Zigula" Gore-Kormanik was analyzing a fraudulent dating app called Dora when he got a pop-up message saying he was receiving a call from Jennifer. title: (No AI) A brief history of AI executives calling for regulation
author: Sean Hollister
content:
![H.A.L.-style glowing red digital eye over a textured digital backdrop.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/STK_414_5_D.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Over the past few days, a lot of people who stand to make a lot of money from AI all [publicly agreed](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/995141/ai-executives-politicians-safety-regulation-anthropic-dario-amodei) that it's time to make everyone slow down before we lose control - including OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, Google DeepMind cofounder Demis Hassabis, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella, and X CEO Elon Musk.

When people who profit from something declare that it's dangerous and needs to be regulated, [there's always reason to be skeptical](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/995186/is-big-techs-ai-slowdown-a-safety-pact-or-a-cartel). But whatever their reason, this is far from the first time AI thought leaders have sounded the alarm.
